raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

DSpark's accept softmax calls FlashInfer under `--enable-deterministic-inference`, which promises batch-invariant ops. On B200, FlashInfer selects its launch from the row count, so a request gets different bits in different batches.

These rounding differences can change a sampled token. With `openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B` and its DSpark draft, one seed and prompt pair (`--random-seed 42`) gives row 0 token 19929 at batch 1 and 19930 at batch 8 and 32. Over 16 such pairs, row 0 differs between batch 1 and 8 for one on main and none with this change.

## Modifications

Under the flag, `SoftmaxTemp` skips FlashInfer and uses its existing Triton kernel. Other runs do not change.

I did not use `torch.softmax`, as #47773 does for draft and verify, because it depends on a row's position at 248094.

## Accuracy Tests

No accuracy eval ran. Rounding changes under the flag: row 0 now gets token 19928 instead, and the same 200 tokens at batch 1, 8 and 32.

I compared rows inside larger batches with the same rows alone, on B200 (torch 2.14.1, FlashInfer 0.7.2):

| Vocabulary | FlashInfer | `torch.softmax` | Triton |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 32000 | Differs at 37 rows and above | No difference | No difference |
| 130560 | Differs at 37 rows and above | No difference | No difference |
| 248094 | Differs at 2 rows and above | Differs at odd positions | No difference |

The regression test at 130560 and 248094 fails on main and with `torch.softmax`, and passes with this change.

MiniCPM5-2B server runs use the cookbook's block size 7 (no B200 cell), target and draft `fa4`, `--cuda-graph-backend-prefill=disabled`, temperature 1.0, and a fresh server per batch size.

`openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B` (vocabulary 248094) does not start on main: `AttributeError: 'MiniCPMV4_7' object has no attribute 'shared_experts_config'`. #41391 is open and removes this error. With it, Triton attention and the default block size, `torch.softmax` gave different bits for 18 of 35 inputs seen at several positions, and this change for none.

Not fixed: sampled DSpark ignores `sampling_seed`, so it is not reproducible by seed. The prefill sampler and top-k or top-p target probabilities still call `torch.softmax`, untested for position dependence.

Not checked: other Blackwell parts, Hopper, ROCm, NPU, Sail, an accept coin flip or `SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_SAMPLING_ACCEPT_GRAPH=1` on a server, and DeepSeek-V4 (the flag refuses `dsv4`).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Flag-on calls at vocabulary 130560 take 0.27 ms instead of 0.15 ms at 448 rows, with the same peak allocation.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

detail.title: [Fix] dspark: Keep accept softmax batch-independent under deterministic inference

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,53 @@
+"""DSpark's accept softmax must not depend on the batch under deterministic inference."""
+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.speculative.dspark.dspark_accept import SoftmaxTemp
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=20, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="4-gpu-b200")
+
+DEVICE = "cuda"
+# On B200, FlashInfer gives a row different bits at 37 rows and above at 130560
+# (MiniCPM5-2B). torch.softmax gives some rows different bits at odd positions at 248094
+# (MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B), so a request needs an odd row count to start at an odd position.
+VOCABS = (130560, 248094)
+BATCH_SIZE = 8
+ROWS_PER_REQUEST = 7
+
+
+class TestDSparkSoftmaxDeterministic(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_request_gets_same_bits_in_any_batch(self):
+        generator = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(0)
+        temperatures = torch.full((BATCH_SIZE,), 0.7, device=DEVICE)
+
+        def softmax(logits):
+            return SoftmaxTemp.execute(
+                logits=logits,
+                temperatures=temperatures[: logits.shape[0] // ROWS_PER_REQUEST],
+                rows_per_request=ROWS_PER_REQUEST,
+            )
+
+        for vocab in VOCABS:
+            logits = torch.randn(
+                (BATCH_SIZE * ROWS_PER_REQUEST, vocab),
+                device=DEVICE,
+                generator=generator,
+            )
+            with get_context().override_server_args(
+                enable_deterministic_inference=True
+            ):
+                batch = softmax(logits).split(ROWS_PER_REQUEST)
+                for slot, request in enumerate(logits.split(ROWS_PER_REQUEST)):
+                    self.assertTrue(
+                        torch.equal(batch[slot], softmax(request.clone())),
+                        f"vocab {vocab}, slot {slot}",
+                    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
